title: Canonical P3E container gate definition
purpose: Establish the canonical identifier set for the P3E container gates and record, per gate, what can be established from evidence. This file defines gates only; it records no execution result. Gate execution state lives in CONTAINER_RUNTIME_CAPABILITY.json and CONTAINER_COMPLETION_LIVE_STATE.json.
scope: exactly C2 and C4 through C19 (17 identifiers). C1 and C3 are deliberately out of scope: neither appears in any P3E record.
alias_basis: owner decision by rasaha on 2026-08-29: C16-image and C17-image are deprecated, noncanonical aliases of C16 and C17 and are not distinct additional gates. This is a ratified decision, not a reconstruction from evidence.

permitted_evidence_sources: Project_documentation/repository/docs/audits/ugence_governance_studio_p3e/ (tracked markdown twins of the P3E audit records; added to the permitted set by owner decision, rasaha, 2026-08-29)
reconstruction_method.finding: The workflow, the deployment tests and the CI scripts contain no C-prefixed gate identifier at all. Gate definitions exist only in the markdown twins of the P3E audit records, and they define two gates individually and the rest only as a group.
reconstruction_method.corroborating_finding: verify_container.sh annotates its checks with section markers of a 'P3E completion' specification (sections 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 13). That specification is not present in the repository, and section numbers are a different numbering scheme from the C identifiers; they are recorded here as a lead, not as a mapping.
reconstruction_method.counting_check: the container job carries 13 named steps, of which 12 predate the pin-conformance guard added alongside this definition, and two of those are setup rather than verification (install-e2e-driver-deps and the checkout/setup actions). That is fewer named steps than the 17 gate identifiers, so no positional or one-to-one correspondence can be derived either.
reconstruction_method.consequence: C2 and C4 are DEFINED from the audit records. C5-C19 receive only a group property and remain individually UNKNOWN. No mapping was invented.
reconstruction_method.correction_2026_08_29: An earlier version of this file stated that no permitted source contained any C-prefixed identifier and that the gates were 'defined nowhere'. That was true of docs/, apps/, deployment/ and .github/, but false of the repository: the tracked Project_documentation/ mirror was not searched and does define C2 and C4. The claim is withdrawn and replaced by the findings below.

completion_specification.evidence: verify_container.sh, packaged_e2e.py and several deployment modules cite sections of a 'P3E completion' specification (sections 2-9 in the audit records; 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 13 in verify_container.sh; 20, 21, 25 in test_container_artifacts.py). A full sweep of the repository - including all 22 files mentioning P3E and the whole Project_documentation tree - finds no document containing that specification.
completion_specification.consequence: the per-gate requirements it would supply are unavailable; do not repeat this search without a new source outside the repository
